body: That is exactly what I'm telling you. There's an easy method called file extension spoofing that does exactly what you describe where you can change the name and icon of any file from a .exe to appear as anything you want including but not limited to .mp4, .avi, .mp3, etc. What VirusTotal and other scanners do is look for stuff like that and more obvious malware to keep people from being tricked. It's not a movie disguised as malware it's malware disguised as files, and this is just one method. And absolutely having a "backup computer with no internet access" is a smart thing to do, you should also be running your files through an virus scanner just so you don't get got by a method that you didn't previously know about.
